title: non-toxic male friendships could save the world? #heatedrivalry #hudc...
transcript: I think seeing a genuine male friendship has broken everyone's brain. And I mean that. Complimentary. I keep joking that Hudson and Connor have solved the male loneliness epidemic, but, like, I kind of do mean it. It is so rare to see two men be physically affectionate, to show their love openly, to be, like, so genuinely excited to see each other, and to do it without any sort of, like, pretense. It's definitely parasocial. But I think that's why every piece of Hudson and Connor content that has come out in the past few weeks, it's just, like, so fun to watch and appreciate. Like, the video behind this photo, like, just gets me. First off, they're genuinely so excited to see each other. And then Connor says, I literally can't see you. And Hudson covers his eyes like this so they can see each other because of all of the flashes. They just wanted to see each other. Which makes sense because their lives have gone so crazy in the past six weeks. And they're each other's only constant, which they keep saying over and over in interviews. They're my stability. They're my best friend. They're my soulmate. They are the thing keeping me sane in all of this. Anyway, I'm sure one day we will stop getting daily Hudson and Connor updates, but today is not that day, and I think it is better for the world. I love it. All friends are important. Hug your Bros
